annotations.title: Get one request received by a webhook URL

description: Returns one request captured by a webhook URL from create_webhook_url, in full: method, path, query, every header the sender set, the body (base64 if it is binary), and a curl command that sends the same request again. Use it after list_webhook_requests when you need the exact bytes, e.g. to check a signature header against the body.

bin.description: The bin id from create_webhook_url (e.g. abc123def456). Its capture URL or private bin page URL also work.

key.description: The bin's secret key from create_webhook_url. Not needed if "bin" is the private bin page URL, which contains it.

name: get_webhook_request
title: Get one request received by a webhook URL
